description: Schema for the administrative sampling-screen audit chain; it contains no test outcome.

required_top_level_fields.prohibited_use: Sampling votes are not model, human test, gold, evidence-support, comparability, or adjudication labels.
required_top_level_fields.schema_version: sampling-screen-v1 (retained for compatibility; replacement stages are hash-linked extensions)
required_top_level_fields.screening_complete: boolean; true only after all active-source initial/replacement agreements and any tiebreak responses are merged
required_top_level_fields.stages: ordered nonempty list: initial screening followed by zero or more hash-linked apply/build/merge replacement cycles; a cycle may omit merge_replacement_tiebreak when initial replacement votes agree; the frozen package ends with one apply_pretest_text_corrections stage anchored to the reversible correction ledger
required_top_level_fields.status: initialized_model_free_awaiting_initial_packets, initial_packets_built_awaiting_responses, awaiting_tiebreak, awaiting_replacement_screen, replacement_packets_built_awaiting_responses, awaiting_replacement_tiebreak, or human_sampling_screen_complete

stage_required_fields.inputs: list of artifact name, row count, and SHA-256; RB-002+ apply stages include source_replacement_summary_parent.json
stage_required_fields.outputs: list of artifact name, row count, and SHA-256
stage_required_fields.stage: initialize, build_initial, merge_initial, merge_tiebreak, a repeatable apply_replacements/build_replacement/merge_replacement_initial/[merge_replacement_tiebreak] cycle, or the single final apply_pretest_text_corrections administrative stage
stage_required_fields.stage_record_sha256: SHA-256 of the stage object before this field is added
